# Apply the Threshold effect to the active (selected) segment of the active Segment Editor.
segmentEditorWidget = slicer.modules.segmenteditor.widgetRepresentation().self().editor

thresholdEffect = segmentEditorWidget.effectByName("Threshold")
if thresholdEffect is None:
    raise RuntimeError("STATE_NOT_APPLIED: Threshold effect is not available in the segment editor")

parameterSetNode = thresholdEffect.parameterSetNode()
if parameterSetNode is None:
    raise RuntimeError("STATE_NOT_APPLIED: no active segment editor parameter set node")
if not parameterSetNode.GetSelectedSegmentID():
    raise RuntimeError("STATE_NOT_APPLIED: no active segment selected")
if not parameterSetNode.GetSegmentationNode():
    raise RuntimeError("STATE_NOT_APPLIED: no segmentation node in the active segment editor")
if not parameterSetNode.GetSourceVolumeNode():
    raise RuntimeError("STATE_NOT_APPLIED: no source volume for thresholding in the active segment editor")

thresholdMin = {threshold_min: 100}
thresholdMax = {threshold_max: 300}

with slicer.util.NodeModify(parameterSetNode):
    thresholdEffect.setParameter("MinimumThreshold", thresholdMin)
    thresholdEffect.setParameter("MaximumThreshold", thresholdMax)

# Read back the parameters to confirm the state was applied.
if abs(thresholdEffect.doubleParameter("MinimumThreshold") - thresholdMin) > 1e-6 \
        or abs(thresholdEffect.doubleParameter("MaximumThreshold") - thresholdMax) > 1e-6:
    raise RuntimeError("STATE_NOT_APPLIED: threshold range parameters did not take effect")

# Apply thresholding to the active segment (previous contents of the segment are overwritten).
thresholdEffect.onApply()
